bucket_reason: Medium confidence after the wall-model stage: the model and cycle map are exact on every record to 1e11, but the non-halting invariant is open, so proof.md waits.
question: W4-6 and its twin (line 612) now have an exact parity-only cycle map: fund one ~2 h carry stage to derive the level recursion and the invariant, try a wall-level closed-language search instead, or park?

options.label: Fund one ~2 h carry stage
options.consequence: Derive what one visit to level m (walls 2m, 2m+1) does to the parity word, which gives the move rates (2^m-1)/2^(2m-1), the 4-position wall windows and the invariant: gaps >= 0, zero gaps and the right end met only in phase C. Test it on random parity words with the cycle map. Output: the invariant and go/no-go on proof.md.

options.label: Wall-level closed-language search
options.consequence: Write a native search for a regular language over the cycle map's wall alphabet (gap parity, zero flag, open/shifted status, head phase) that is closed under the pass/sweep steps. A hit is the invariant without understanding the recursion; Coq would then need the 22 rules as lemmas plus a checker. It may not close (bit-level CTL failed on 25 sets).

options.label: Park both lines
options.consequence: No compute. Both lines go to STUCK with the exact model, cycle map and 1e11 checks kept for a later multi-level-counter method.

rationale: The map reads gaps only by parity (+100 on every gap: no change in 96,000 cycles).
Move rates fit one formula for walls 2..21: a uniform recursion, not a cryptid.
After start-up, zero gaps and the right end are met only in phase C: a clear target.

evidence.text: Fig 2: walls per cycle; each level wiggles half as often as the one before.
Rule-only model = TM at every E record to 1e11: 223,095/223,095 (line 99) and 223,102/223,102 (line 612), step counts included.
Cycle map: 0 mismatches on 446,138 one-cycle checks; zero gaps met in phase C 85,695 times, never in A/F/D after k = 3,519.
Per 65,536 cycles wall 2m moves (2^m-1)*2^(17-2m) times, wall 2m+1 half that (walls 2..21).

effort_if_yes: ~2 h agent time, light compute (the cycle map runs 1e11 steps' worth of cycles in ~1 min).
